categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in integrated circuit (IC) testing services, including wafer testing and chip final testing. It also engages in IC testing solution development and related supporting services such as wafer thinning, polishing, laser grooving, and laser stealth cutting. The business focuses on high-end IC testing for various chip types and applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced IC testing technologies including digital, analog, mixed-signal, RF, and SoC testing solutions. It develops proprietary test programs, customizes test equipment and fixtures, and employs automated test equipment (ATE) and probe stations. The company also invests in R&D for emerging technologies like Chiplet, SIP, WLCSP, MEMS sensors, high-computing chips (CPU, GPU, AI), automotive electronics, and 5G communications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are chip design companies (fabless) requiring wafer and chip final testing services. The company serves diverse markets including 5G communications, automotive electronics (BMS, ECU, smart cockpit, ADAS), industrial control, sensors (MEMS), AI, storage (NAND/NOR Flash, DDR), AIoT, unmanned driving, and security chips. Customers are mainly domestic chip designers and manufacturers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with testing and service bases in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area (Dongguan) and the Yangtze River Delta region (Shanghai). It also has subsidiaries in Hong Kong and other Chinese cities. Its geographic focus aligns with major semiconductor industry clusters in China.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates as an independent third-party IC testing service provider positioned downstream in the semiconductor supply chain. It provides testing services to chip design companies after wafer fabrication and before chip packaging or final product assembly, bridging the gap between manufacturing and end-use applications.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding high-end IC testing capacity, especially for automotive, high-computing, 5G, sensor, AI, and storage chips. The company emphasizes R&D investment to develop advanced test solutions and equipment customization. It focuses on talent cultivation, innovation in test methodologies, and building a sustainable R&D team to maintain technological leadership and meet evolving market demands.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through service fees from wafer testing and chip final testing. The company adopts an order-based production model with customized test solutions tailored to client chip specifications. It also earns income from related services such as test program development, equipment upgrades, and testing data analytics.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the largest independent third-party IC testing providers in China but faces competition from Taiwanese firms like King Yuan Electronics, Siliconware Precision, and others. Compared to IDM and foundry companies, it offers more flexible and neutral testing services. It leverages local market proximity and technical capabilities to compete against both domestic and international players.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 503 million, an 11.19% increase year-over-year, marking a historical high. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 21.7 million, down 32.16% due to increased fixed costs from capacity expansion. Total assets reached RMB 2.07 billion, growing 22.45%. The company continues to invest heavily in R&D and capacity expansion, indicating a growth trajectory focused on scaling and technological advancement.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its advanced, proprietary IC testing solutions, broad chip coverage, and ability to customize test programs and equipment. It offers high-quality, reliable, and timely testing services with a strong local presence in China’s semiconductor hubs. Its neutral third-party status, deep technical expertise, and comprehensive service ecosystem provide customers with competitive advantages in product quality assurance and market speed.
